items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Shavers and Dizzy Gillespie both went to this school.

ctx.x: said, "You know, son, this office is just a front; I just come here to get away from home. I've been making my living off 'St. Louis Blues' for the past forty years." So I never did get a job as a copyist, which was probably fortunate, because I continued studying.

Charlie Shavers and Dizzy Gillespie both went to this school. Dizzy was a bad boy; Dizzy got kicked out of school. He hasn't changed a bit either. Dizzy was always dizzy, you know, kind of a devil, always doing nutty things. But anyhow...
How old were you when you started going to this school?
